links.outcome: Drug recommendation, dosage, adverse reaction, and interaction task performance of knowledge-grounded LLM versus generic LLMs
links.effect: Knowledge-grounded DrugGPT outperformed a wide range of existing LLMs and reached state-of-the-art performance across all metrics with fewer parameters than generic LLMs. No numbers are given in the abstract.
links.quote: DrugGPT outperforms a wide range of existing LLMs and achieves state-of-the-art performance across all metrics with fewer parameters than generic LLMs.

screen.reason: The paper introduces DrugGPT, a novel knowledge-grounded collaborative LLM architecture, and benchmarks it on clinical drug-related tasks against generic LLMs.
